g.title: note
g.text: Orange: IPv4 Netfilter hooks / iptables-legacy priorities
Green: modern BPF attachment points (not available in old 2.x)
Purple: modern nft device hooks; no fixed nft table names
Optional hooks require configuration/modules. Every hook may DROP/QUEUE.
Netfilter BPF (since 6.4): inside orange hooks at configured priority.
NAT rules normally see only the first packet; conntrack applies later translations.
Default raw priority shown; raw_before_defrag can move it to -450.
Not a historical 2014/2.x reconstruction; bridge/ARP/IPsec/offloads excluded.
